{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify rows where status is 'refunded' but converted is 1
refunded_converted = df[(df['status'] == 'refunded') & (df['converted'] == 1)]
print(refunded_converted[['order_id', 'channel', 'status', 'converted']])"}
